dcat_keyword_sm: Ministry of Northern Development Mines Natural Resources and Forestry
dct_description_sm:
The dataset contains line features which define trails that are used for:
  • hiking
  • backpacking
  • biking
  • horseback riding
  • cross-country skiing
  • snowmobiling
  • access to campgrounds
